_comment: Olympiad dispatcher (dispatch.py). Token variables are names in the repository's .env, never tokens. Lanes in priority order: a match goes to the first lane one of its players belongs to; workers = matches at once per host. Azure Astra: 2. About 7.6% of its calls hit HTTP 429 (rate_limit_exceeded) on one deployment and were completed by the proxy's failover to another (431 of 5,700 calls, 2026-10-04); the 429s were invisible in the call status.

azure-astra.note: one Azure key, failover over three deployments (AZURE_DEPLOYMENTS)
